page.layout: One page, centred title page. Top: "DE" small, then the large title lines. Middle: "ET DE" and the title of the law. Below: the author and a line on the index. Foot: printer's imprint. A library stamp sits at upper right over the title, and a handwritten number at top right; neither is transcribed.

l.i: Seriem omnium quæ hoc tractatu continentur,

main_text.l: Typis GERHARDI KETELII, Typographi ordinarii. Año M. D. C. V.

page.notes: Library stamp "BIBLIOTHECA REGIA MONACENSIS" at upper right, and a handwritten number at top right, are not printed text and are left out. The line "FLVMIN" is partly covered by the stamp; the rest is unreadable, so the final letters are marked [?]. The "E" of "VRBE" is also partly covered by the stamp and is marked [?]. The "Q" of "VTRIVSQVE" is printed with a superscript flourish, transcribed as UTRIUSQUE. "VBBONE" is transcribed as UBBONE per the u/v rule in the transcription (initial vowel U) — the printed form is VBBONE. The imprint "Año" is printed with a tilde over n for "Anno" and is kept as printed. No page number or running head is printed on this page.
